description: The Mopo project deposits a spreadsheet for simplified pan-European methane and prospective hydrogen networks. The Zenodo page identifies country-level interconnections, production and storage capacity, related costs and selected technology parameters. Capacities draw on ENTSOG network-development plans; costs use published tariffs where available and averages or realistic assumptions elsewhere. The public XLSX is about 56 KB under CC BY 4.0. A modeller could use these links and capacities as starting constraints for gas, hydrogen or sector-coupled energy simulations. A limitation is that it is an aggregated planning representation, not a pipeline-by-pipeline hydraulic model or evidence that the hydrogen network has been built. Cost assumptions with no public tariff should be treated as estimates, and upstream ENTSOG terms remain separate. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this source spreadsheet. The XLSX was not downloaded, so country codes, formulas, year of each capacity and internal source notes were not independently checked.
